work_completed.description: What you actually finished and verified. Do not list intentions.

work_not_completed.description: Work the phase document asked for that you did not finish. Be honest; the driver checks.

blockers.description: Anything that stopped you and needs a human decision.

gate_files_touched.description: Any test, .lit, Makefile, CMakeLists or registry JSON you created or modified, with a one-line reason for each. The driver fingerprints these independently; omitting one is detected.
